title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-07-16

ai_review.summary: Spectacular early‑1966 recording with top‑shelf playing that captures the magic of the era.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the astonishing sound quality for a tape from 1966, calling it “spectacular” and praising the performance as “top shelf.” The recording offers a vivid glimpse into the band’s early chemistry, making it a prized listen for second‑generation heads despite the lack of detailed setlist information.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars and highlight excellent playing and surprisingly clear audio; with only two reviews, confidence is moderate but the consensus is strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Spectacular clarity for a 1966 tape; crisp, well‑balanced sound that exceeds typical expectations for recordings of this era.
